name: Computer name (WS-XX-XXX)
desc: PC name follows the standard WS-XX-XXX, X = a digit (e.g. WS-01-002). Check only — rename by hand, it needs a reboot.

name: Clock in sync
desc: Shows this PC's system time, and checks it against the coordinator's clock (within 60s) - the reference every version, deploy and health sample is stamped against. Apply resyncs w32time and, failing that, sets the clock from the coordinator.

name: Windows Update disabled
desc: No automatic updates: the NoAutoUpdate policy is set and the wuauserv service is disabled. A sim must never reboot or swap a driver mid-session.

name: Notifications disabled
desc: No toasts, notification centre, tips or Defender alerts popping over the sim. Registry only, no reboot forced.

name: Max performance, never sleeps
desc: High/Ultimate performance plan, every idle timeout set to never (sleep, hibernate, monitor, disk), hibernation and USB selective suspend off, and no device allowed to power down to save power.

name: Wake-on-LAN ready
desc: The NIC holding this PC's coordinator-facing IP wakes on a magic packet and is never powered down - what the Wake on LAN action in PC status needs. BIOS/UEFI wake must still be enabled by hand.

name: Wallpaper and login image
desc: Desktop + lock-screen image matches the standard.

name: SSH open
desc: OpenSSH server installed, running, firewall open.

name: Hardware sensors (CPU temp)
desc: This PC can report a CPU temperature to HealthCheck. Boards with no ACPI thermal zone (most AMD desktops) need LibreHardwareMonitor + the PawnIO kernel driver it reads sensors through: build the assets with deploy/fetch-lhm.sh and deploy/fetch-pawnio.sh, then Apply - it unpacks the DLLs and installs PawnIO silently. Also needs the agent running elevated. NVIDIA GPU temps need none of this (nvidia-smi).

name: VC++ Redistributables (x86 + x64)
desc: Latest Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtimes, both architectures.
